stem: In triangle \(ABC\), what is the value of \(x\)?
solution: The angles of a triangle add up to \(180^{\circ}\): \(48 + 77 + x = 180\).

explanation.B: Incorrect. This comes from adding \(48 + 77\) incorrectly as 115 before subtracting from 180.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(48 + 77\), the sum of the two given angles; it still must be subtracted from 180.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(360 - 125\); the angles of a triangle add up to 180°, not 360°.

verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert abs(ang('C','A','B')-48)<0.1 and abs(ang('A','B','C')-77)<0.1
ans=180-48-77
assert abs(ang('A','C','B')-ans)<0.1
assert value(choices[answer])==ans==55
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
